original_fields.Title: Description serious injury outcome indicators
original_fields.Content: Serious injury outcome indicators present the annual number and rate of serious injury outcomes in New Zealand, through a set of indicators for fatal and non-fatal injuries.

original_fields.Title: Serious injury outcome indicators: 2000–2021 – 1
original_fields.Content:
Data note

Mortality collection data for 2019 was not available at the time of publication. Mortality data for 2016 to 2018 was revised as normal.

original_fields.Title: Serious injury outcome indicators: 2000–2021 – more data
original_fields.Content:

original_fields.Content:
